comment: Falsifiability registry: every step in VALIDATE_STEPS ∪ STOP_HOOK_STEPS must carry at least one mechanical proof that it CAN go red. Proof kinds: 'fixture' (a repo test file that spawns the real gate and asserts exit 1 — ref must exist), 'selftest' (a literal step-name string that must appear in .github/workflows/selftest.yml), 'runner' (the step wraps a vendor tool whose non-zero exit is the red; OUR wiring's failure propagation is proven by the validate-runner tests — ref must exist). scripts/check-canary-coverage.mjs enforces bidirectional closure: an unregistered step OR a stale registry entry reds the PR that caused it. Guard-rule falsifiability is a PER-RULE closure, not a count: check-canary-coverage.mjs imports the pure-data rule tables from .claude/hooks/lib/guard-rules.mjs (BASH_RULES, WRITE_PROTECTED, WRITE_GLOBAL_CHECKS) and asserts every rule id has a behavioral deny/allow case (a RULE_CANARIES entry) in tests/hooks/hook-contract.test.mjs — a rule added without a canary reds the PR. hookRules below keeps only a human-readable grep-able deny example per surface. PORT NOTE (W6): the DEVICE-lane wall-clock canaries — the 300ms busy-loop that must red the startup-budget measurement and the broken-testID that must red the Maestro flow lane — cannot be registered yet: they need the W6 emulator lanes, this schema has no deferred-proof kind, and inventing one would let a lane ship 'proven' by a job that does not exist. They arm in W6 together with the bootstrap/device selftest jobs; until then the mobile-e2e / perf-lane MEASUREMENT halves are recorded as honest losses in their lane notes below and in docs/harness/gates-catalog.md.

format.note: biome ci exits non-zero on any diff

gate-integrity.ref: Canary 6: tamper a gate script on disk → gate-integrity must FAIL

types.note: tsc -b exits non-zero on type errors

lint.note: eslint --max-warnings 0 exits non-zero on any finding

provenance.ref: Canary 4: strip SOURCE citations from decision sites → provenance must FAIL

provenance.note: uncited decision sites red naming file+line; wrong-group corpus cites red naming site, group and cited groups; a bare-URL SOURCE on a host outside tools/lib/citation-domains.mjs reds naming the host; tools/provenance-overrides.json is the reviewed escape and malformed entries fail closed

expo-policy.ref: Canary 1: NSAllowsArbitraryLoads + undeclared permission + secret-shaped extra → expo-policy must FAIL

expo-policy.note: runs the REAL gate against fixture trees with a stub expo CLI: identity drift vs identity.lock.json, runtimeVersion != { policy: 'appVersion' }, ATS/cleartext holes, non-loopback ATS exceptions, unreviewed permission AND stale allowlist entry (bidirectional), unreviewed plugin, secret-shaped extra key, secret-shaped EXPO_PUBLIC_ name in source, splash/adaptive-icon color off the generated dark canvas token, eas.json appVersionSource/autoIncrement/secret-env sanity — each red; missing node_modules skips loudly locally and FAILS CLOSED in CI

native-deps.ref: Canary 2: stage the generated android/ dir → native-deps must FAIL (CNG purity)

native-deps.note: expo install --check drift (stub CLI exits 1 listing packages) reds verbatim; a tracked apps/mobile/android|ios file reds (CNG purity, pre-stamp); a reasonless tools/expo-plugins.json entry reds; a local config plugin without a same-basename .test.* reds; zero plugins is an honest OK

prompts.ref: Canary 7: tamper a hash-locked prompt → prompts must FAIL

schema-rls.ref: Canary 5: remove FORCE RLS from the migration → schema-rls must FAIL

migrations.ref: Canary 3: edit a committed migration → migrations must FAIL

dead-code.note: knip --strict exits non-zero on unused exports/files

architecture.note: depcruise exits non-zero on rule violations; the mobile/server boundary rules are pinned by scripts/check-rule-integrity.mjs (G28)

build.note: gzip ratchet: a committed tools/perf-baseline.json with a tiny total → build red naming measured vs baseline × ratioCap and the `pnpm perf:baseline` re-baseline ceremony; exactly AT the cap stays green; absent baseline → NOTE naming the file+command while the absolute byte budgets keep enforcing; malformed baseline JSON/shape → red, never fail-open; bundle-purity markers (postgres DSNs, EXPO_TOKEN, sk_live_) in a fixture dist red

build.ref: Canary 12: a tiny committed perf-baseline → the build gzip ratchet must FAIL

styleguide.note: raw hex/rgb()/named-color literals in color positions red; numeric literals in dimension style keys red; inline style={{…}} raw numerics outside the components home red; a hand-edited tokens.gen.ts reds the regen-diff; a below-min contrast pair (AAA 7:1 body pairs, AA 4.5 elsewhere) reds with the computed ratio; primitive-boundary (controlPrimitives) and status-surface (statusSurfaces) scans red per manifest data, and their allow lists fail closed on malformed/stale entries

styleguide.ref: Canary 8: raw hex + inline-style literals in a screen → styleguide must FAIL

perf-budget.note: budget arithmetic, subjects[] closure inverses (missing file, undeclared perfSubject, subject+subjects ambiguity), density-signal closure, marker-count scaling, and the G15 effect-cleanup leak scan (a registered listener/interval/rAF/Observer with no teardown in the RETURNED cleanup reds; comments are blanked first; effectCleanupAllow fails closed on malformed/stale entries)

route-manifest.note: expo-router derivation: an app/ route file claimed by no ROUTES entry reds; a manifest path disagreeing with the derived URL ((group) elision, index→parent, [param]→:param, [...param]→*param) reds; missing states.loading/empty/error test ids red; stale manifest/allowlist entries naming missing files red; +not-found is required; an empty ROUTES array reds

route-manifest.ref: Canary 9: an orphan app/ route file + an unregistered screen → route-manifest must FAIL

e2e.note: jest-expo fast lane: a failing jest exit propagates; a zero-passed run reds as a vacuous pass (anti-vacuity parses the Tests: summary line, not Test Suites:); jest-expo unresolvable skips loudly locally and FAILS CLOSED in CI

e2e.ref: Canary 11: a zero-test jest run → the e2e gate must FAIL (anti-vacuity)

docs-sync.ref: Canary 13: remove a numbered gates-catalog section → docs-sync must FAIL

rls-isolation.ref: RLS runner FAILS CLOSED without a database (CI=true)
rls-isolation.note: PORT NOTE (W6): the source harness's Canary 9 (drop the keyset index → the DAL plan probe reds on a Sort over the owner partition) needs a live Postgres + installed scaffold, which is the W6 bootstrap lane; it arms there. Until then the fail-closed proof above and the template's own tests/rls suite are the registered coverage — recorded honestly rather than pointing at a job that does not exist.

unit.note: vitest exits non-zero on failing tests or coverage-threshold misses

mobile-unit.note: jest (jest-expo preset, --coverage) exits non-zero on failing tests or coverageThreshold misses; the e2e gate's anti-vacuity fixture additionally proves a zero-test jest run cannot read as green

diff-coverage.note: an uncovered new src file (absent from both coverage maps) and a below-floor changed file both red naming file + metric; apps/mobile/** files are held to the jest floors, everything else to the vitest floors, and a file both runners measure merges; a missing coverage-final.json fails closed

duplication.note: a token-clone pasted across apps/*/src or packages/*/src reds naming both sites + a content fingerprint; tools/duplication-allow.json mutes an accepted clone by fingerprint and malformed/absent entries fail closed

duplication.ref: Canary 14: a pasted token clone across two modules → duplication must FAIL

i18n.note: STATIC half: a hardcoded user-facing string (JSX text, accessibilityLabel/placeholder/label/title/alt, or the copy-carrying object literals) reds naming the string + the catalog key to add; Intl./toLocale*/.toFixed( outside apps/mobile/src/i18n/ reds; a dead catalog key reds; the polyfill/locale-data closure reds both ways; tools/i18n-allow.json fails closed on malformed/stale entries. The BEHAVIOURAL half (pseudo-locale + RTL sweep) lives in the RNTL fast lane and the W6 Maestro lane — a runtime-assembled string is invisible to this scan by construction (stated in the gate header).

i18n.ref: Canary 16: a hardcoded user-facing string → the static i18n gate must FAIL

test-quality.note: an assertion-free test body reds naming the test; a committed .only reds with NO reviewed escape; .skip/.todo modifiers red as declared-never-run; an assertion inside a comment does not satisfy the gate; tools/test-quality-allow.json mutes by test title and a missing reason fails closed. Deliberately GAMEABLE ALONE (expect(true).toBe(true) clears it) — the primary control is the mutation lane.

test-quality.ref: Canary 15: a committed .only → test-quality must FAIL

mobile-perf.note: CLOSURE half: a src/routes.ts id with no maestro/flows/<id>.yaml AND no tools/startup-budget.json row reds turn-fatally; stale flows/rows naming a dead route id red; measurement mode reds on a budget overrun in artifacts/perf-results.json and FAILS CLOSED when the perf lane env is set but the artifact is absent. The MEASUREMENT half needs the W6 emulator lane (see the registry-level PORT NOTE).

mobile-perf.ref: Canary 10: a route with no Maestro flow / no startup-budget row → the mobile-perf closure must FAIL

static.note: runs `node tools/validate.mjs --min-floor` — every step in it is proven in #steps above.

unit.note: runs vitest --coverage, the jest-expo coverage run, check-diff-coverage, check-duplication and check-test-quality — all proven in #steps above.

mutation.note: the PRIMARY assertion-quality control — the only check that asks what coverage cannot: change the code, does a test go red? A surviving mutant the committed baseline does not accept reds the lane naming file, mutator and the exact edit; an accepted survivor with an EMPTY reason reds; a NoCoverage mutant counts as a survivor; identity is position-independent; an absent baseline self-disables locally and FAILS CLOSED in CI.

mutation.ref: an untested branch must red the mutation lane
mutation.note: end-to-end on a real scaffold (selftest job canary-mutation): ONE untested env-override branch added to the 99%-mutation-scored apps/server/src/auth/verify.ts leaves vitest, diff-coverage and test-quality GREEN and only the mutation ratchet red — checked, not asserted.

runtime-rls.note: runs `node tests/rls/run-rls.mjs` — proven under the 'rls-isolation' step above (fail-closed selftest proof; the W6 bootstrap lane arms the keyset plan-probe canary).

e2e-fast.note: runs the jest-expo RNTL suite behind the `e2e` step (states sweep over every ROUTES entry, flows, boot, primitives a11y) — proven under the 'e2e' step above, whose gate asserts the run is neither failing nor vacuous.

integration-lane.note: PORT NOTE (W6): the mobile<->server seam smoke (LIVE_PROOF live-api suite against a real server + Postgres). Its red-proof — strip the Authorization header from the api client and the create->list->paginate smoke must 401 — needs the installed-scaffold + database selftest lane and arms in W6 with it; the jest runner's own failure propagation is proven under 'e2e'/'mobile-unit' above. Recorded honestly rather than pointing at a selftest job that does not exist yet.

changes.note: a paths-filter job: it computes which downstream lanes run and asserts nothing itself. Its failure mode (mis-filtering) is covered by the gated lanes' own vars/paths conditions, not by an injection.

native.note: prebuild-x2 determinism: runs `expo prebuild` twice from a clean tree and diffs — the assertion is a byte compare whose non-zero exit is the red, plus expo-doctor and gates proven in #steps. PORT NOTE (W6): an end-to-end injection (a config plugin emitting nondeterministic output must red the compare) arms with the W6 device/bootstrap lanes.

mobile-e2e.note: PORT NOTE (W6): the Maestro device lane (emulator + built APK), vars-gated OFF (HARNESS_W6_DEVICE_LANES) until W6 arms it. Its red-proof — a broken testID must fail the flow — needs the emulator lane itself; registered as an honest loss here and in docs/harness/gates-catalog.md rather than claimed via a job that does not run.

perf-lane.note: the budget arithmetic + closure inverses + measurement-mode fail-closed behavior. PORT NOTE (W6): the wall-clock canary (a 300ms busy-loop on a route's boot path must red the startup-budget measurement) needs the emulator lane and arms in W6 — the measurement half is an honest loss until then.
